issues.title: Autoresponder email not sent to leads
issues.problem_statement: Leads were coming in from the customer's form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

issues.title: Sender domain verification
issues.problem_statement: Support advised that the autoresponder email can sometimes land in spam, so verifying the sender domain is recommended.

items.description: Customer turned on the autoresponder option in the form settings and saved it, following support's guidance, then submitted a test form from a different email and confirmed the autoresponder email arrived.
evidence: इसे चालू करके सेव कर दीजिए।
हाँ, ईमेल आ गया! अब सही चल रहा है।

items.description: Support explained that the email can sometimes go to spam, so verifying the sender domain is a good idea, and that this can be done in the email domain section of the settings.
evidence: ईमेल कभी-कभी स्पैम में जा सकता है, इसलिए सेंडर डोमेन वेरिफ़ाई कर लेना अच्छा रहेगा।

items.description: Customer will verify the sender domain in the email domain section of the settings.
evidence: ठीक है, मैं कल सुबह वह कर लूँगा।

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
